text:
Lina P: hi everyone, first week here! quick question: where's the single source of truth for onboarding docs and team templates in Notion? i can see a few versions and don't want to edit the wrong one.
Sam G: welcome Lina :tada: canonical docs live in Notion > Engineering workspace. onboarding checklists are under Engineering / Onboarding / Starter Kits. templates are in Engineering / Playbooks.
Lina P: got it — i clicked duplicate on the 'service-checklist' template but it failed with a permissions error. do i need to request access somewhere?
Jess L: yes — you need the `engineering-editors` group to duplicate and publish templates. use the slash command `/request-docs-access engineering-editors` or ping @docs-admins. include your manager to speed approval.
Devex Bot: Access request recorded: `/request-docs-access engineering-editors` from Lina P at 1869990020. Approvals usually take 10-30 minutes. To expedite, DM @jess.l or @sam.g.
Marco H: small process note — our convention is to duplicate templates into /People/<your-name>/Drafts first, then move to Engineering/Team Pages when ready. helps with ownership and tidy nav.
Lina P: thanks — is there a naming convention for runbooks or checklists so search works?
Sam G: yep: `service-runbook YYYY-MM` or `service-onboarding-v1`. add tags like `#runbook` or `#onboarding`, and add a 1-line summary at the top.
Jess L: also, if you find an old duplicate, please comment `@docs-admins please archive` on that page instead of editing directly. keeps redirects clean.
Lina P: all good — i submitted the access request and will wait. appreciate the quick tips :pray:
